questions.q: Explain why a person with emphysema (fewer, larger alveoli) is often breathless. (3)
questions.a: Smaller surface area (1), less oxygen diffuses into blood (1), less aerobic respiration / breathless on exertion (1)

questions.q: Explain why enzymes stop working at high temperature. (3)
questions.a: Bonds break / active site changes shape (1); substrate no longer fits (1); enzyme is denatured (1)
questions.model: Three marks, three links: heat breaks the shape, the shape no longer fits, so the enzyme is denatured.
